<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A whole sign-in page: the AuthCard placed in the page. Axes: layout (split: a picture panel beside the card,
  centered: the card on a tinted page, minimal: the card alone in a narrow column), side (end, start: the side
  of the picture), mode, social. The page's heading is the card's title.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { AuthSwitch, AuthVisual } from "./auth-layout.types";
  import type { AuthLabels } from "./auth-card.types";

  export type AuthLayoutProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    submit: string;
    switchTo: AuthSwitch;
    labels: AuthLabels;
    visual: AuthVisual;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    layout?: "split" | "centered" | "minimal";
    side?: "end" | "start";
    mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
    social?: "none" | "show" | "first";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import AuthCard from "../blocks/auth-card.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    submit,
    switchTo,
    labels,
    visual,
    level = 1,
    layout = "split",
    side = "end",
    mode = "signin",
    social = "none",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: AuthLayoutProps = $props();
</script>

<Block tag="div" class="w-full" data-layout={layout} data-slot="auth-layout">
  <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "py-12")} data-slot="container">
    {#if ((layout as string) === "split")}
      <Grid cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-8">
        <Box class="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-center">
          <AuthCard
            id={id}
            title={title}
            text={text}
            submit={submit}
            switchText={switchTo.text}
            switchLink={switchTo.link}
            switchHref={switchTo.href}
            labels={labels}
            mode={mode}
            layout="plain"
            social={social}
            level={level}
            landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
          />
        </Box>
        <Stack
          gap="4"
          align="stretch"
          class={cn(
            "justify-end rounded bg-muted p-8",
            (((side as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "md:order-last")
          )}
          data-slot="visual"
        >
          <MediaFrame alt={visual.title} ratio="4/3" />
          <Title as={2} size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {visual.title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {visual.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
    {:else if ((layout as string) === "centered")}
      <Box class="mx-auto w-full max-w-md rounded bg-muted p-6">
        <AuthCard
          id={id}
          title={title}
          text={text}
          submit={submit}
          switchText={switchTo.text}
          switchLink={switchTo.link}
          switchHref={switchTo.href}
          labels={labels}
          mode={mode}
          social={social}
          level={level}
          landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
        />
      </Box>
    {:else}
      <Box class="mx-auto w-full max-w-sm">
        <AuthCard
          id={id}
          title={title}
          text={text}
          submit={submit}
          switchText={switchTo.text}
          switchLink={switchTo.link}
          switchHref={switchTo.href}
          labels={labels}
          mode={mode}
          layout="plain"
          social={social}
          level={level}
          landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
        />
      </Box>
    {/if}
  </Container>
</Block>
